issue_context.title: AudioStreamMicrophone crash on scene-reload
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.3.stable, 4.3-beta1
- Not Reproducible in: 4.0.4.stable, 4.1.4.stable, 4.2.2.stable, 4.3-dev1, 4.3-dev2, 4.3-dev3, 4.3-dev4, 4.3-dev5, 4.3-dev6

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable - Windows 10.0.22631 - GLES3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6109) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-11800H @ 2.30GHz (16 Threads)

### Issue description

My Project sometimes crashes without an error-message, when the Main Scene gets reloaded. It seems to only crash if I reload the same scene and not if I load it from a different Scene. It doesnt crash evertime, only about 30-50 % of the time. The main issue seems to come from the AudioStreamPlayer streaming an AudioStreamMicrophone when trying to load the scene.

### Steps to reproduce

To reproduce just click on the Button a few times, and it will crash randomly. Note that ProjectSettings/Audio/Driver/Enable_Input has to be activated (Which it is in this Project)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[MRP.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17002209/MRP.zip)

review_comments: Are you sure this is the proper way to fix the error?
This works because `.Reset()` is failing when `ComPtr` is `NULL`.
Comparing changes with #91975 (this seems to be a partial revert), the `using Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr;` statement and `#include <wrl/client.h>` can likely also be removed?

The ComPtr is being used to manage other WASAPI structs.

Only for these it fails.

Not in the header file though, so the include and `using` should be moved to the `.cpp`.
Our policy is to include things only where they're needed.
